sections: Redact a PDF for free – real removal, not a black box on top

Redaction means permanently removing sensitive information – names, account numbers, addresses, signatures – before you share a document. The most common mistake is drawing black rectangles in an ordinary PDF editor: the text underneath is still there and can be copied out. This tool does real redaction. Every page that contains a redaction is rebuilt as an image with the boxes burned in, so the hidden text, its font data and any selectable layer underneath are gone. Pages without redactions are copied untouched, and document metadata is cleared.

You can redact by **searching** for words or phrases (comma-separated, e.g. *John Smith, 4111 1111*), by automatically finding **all e-mail addresses** and **phone numbers**, or by **drawing boxes** over anything – photos, signatures, stamps, handwriting – on the page preview.
How to black out text on a PDF

steps: Type words to redact, and/or tick e-mails and phone numbers.
Draw boxes on the preview for anything else; use the page buttons to move between pages.
Choose black or white boxes and press Redact.
Download and check the redacted copy.

sections: Black or white redaction?

Black boxes are the convention for legal and government documents because they make it obvious that something was removed. White boxes (sometimes called *white-out redaction*) blend into the page and are used when a clean look matters, for example in published examples or templates. Both remove the content equally.
Is there a way to redact text in a PDF without Adobe Pro?

Yes – that is exactly what this page does, free and in your browser. Professional suites offer the same kind of true redaction in their paid editions; free viewers and many basic editors only offer drawing shapes, which is not redaction.

Search tips

list: Leave *Match case* off to catch SMITH, Smith and smith.
Search finds real text only; for scanned pages, draw boxes or run OCR first.
Numbers formatted differently (4111-1111 vs 4111 1111) need each format listed.
Always review every page of the result before sharing.

sections: Can I redact a PDF that has been signed?
You can, but redacting changes the document, so any digital signature becomes invalid. Redact first, then sign the final version.
Other places sensitive data hides

Comments, form fields, attachments, bookmarks and layers can also contain personal data. Redacted pages are rebuilt without them; for the rest of the document, consider [Flatten PDF](/flatten-pdf/) and [Remove PDF metadata](/remove-pdf-metadata/).

sections: Worked example

Before sharing a bank statement with a landlord, tick *Auto-redact e-mail addresses* and *phone numbers*, add your account number as search text, and press Redact. Every match is covered with a solid box and removed from the text layer, so searching the output for the number finds nothing.
Privacy

Everything happens inside your browser tab with pdf-lib and PDF.js. The PDF is read from your disk into memory, processed there and saved straight back to your device. It is never uploaded, stored or logged, and the tool keeps working offline once the page has loaded – which makes it suitable for contracts, medical records, HR files, bank statements and anything else you would not e-mail to a stranger.
